notes: The chore board separates one-off to-dos from the day's chores: they get their own To-do heading and no longer count toward "done today" ("0 of 2 done today · 6 to-dos"). One-off chores can now have an optional due date, shown as "due Fri" and turning red once overdue; the home page shows each person's to-do count. Also: the Maintenance card no longer wraps "in 1d" on a phone, the phone footer is tidier, and points cards without a goal say so.
